entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse. Just need the label.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, can I ask what the issue is? Is it a technical fault or...?

Look, I just want a yes or no. The device is **hard to use**, the interface is **confusing**, and honestly, I **expected more** for the price. The **user manual** didn't clarify anything. Can I return it or not?
I understand completely. No need to go into detail. Let me just check the policy against your delivery date... one moment.
Okay, yes, I can definitely process this for you. Your purchase is from 23 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return period. I've just approved the return in our system.
Great. So you'll email me a shipping label?
That's right. The prepaid label is on its way to the email address we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print it, attach it to the box, and you'll be all set.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
